project_context.description: A heartfelt, single-page emotional farewell letter from 'jaycee' to 'Michelle' who is leaving for China. Features a dark theme with a 3D flowing purple aurora/silk background, glowing stars, and large frosted glassmorphic cards with bold typography.
project_context.tone: Emotional, intimate, cinematic, magical, twilight-sparkle inspired

rules.spacing: Use generous line-height (leading-loose) and vertical margins (mb-8) for maximum readability on small screens.

layouts.strategy: Mobile-first continuous scroll. A fixed, full-viewport 3D canvas sits securely in the background. The foreground consists of a scrollable wrapper containing perfectly padded glassmorphic cards.
layouts.spacing: p-6 sm:p-12 for the main glassmorphic cards. Massive vertical gaps between content blocks (e.g., pt-32 pb-64) to allow users to pause, breathe, and admire the 3D aurora background.
layouts.cards: High-end crystal glassmorphism: Use rounded-[2rem] or rounded-3xl. Do not stretch cards full width on mobile; maintain a safe 16px margin on left and right.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: bg-white/[0.03] backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/[0.08] shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] backdrop-saturate-150
visual_enhancers.lighting: Subtle inner glow on the cards to separate them from the dark background.
visual_enhancers.twilight_nod: Include very subtle star/sparkle motifs or glowing purple accents to honor the My Little Pony 'Twilight Sparkle' theme.

3d_libraries.implementation: 1. Create a <Canvas> component with fixed positioning (inset-0, z-[-1]). 2. Use <MeshDistortMaterial> (from @react-three/drei) on a large plane or sphere, colored in deep purples and violets, slowly animating its distortion and speed to simulate flowing silk/aurora. 3. Layer <Sparkles count={200} scale={15} size={3} speed={0.3} opacity={0.8} color={'#E9D5FF'} /> over the mesh to create the floating magical stars. 4. Use ambient and directional lights with pink/purple hues to beautifully light the silk.

motion.framer_motion: Wrap each paragraph of the letter in a <motion.p> with 'whileInView' fade-in and slight slide-up animations (initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }}, whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}, viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-20%' }}).
motion.scroll: The scroll must feel smooth and deliberate. Reveal text blocks sequentially.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure white text over the dark glass panels passes APCA standards. Use subtle text-shadow if necessary for legibility over bright background nodes.
accessibility.aria: Add aria-hidden='true' to the 3D Canvas container so screen readers skip it.
accessibility.data_testid: Add data-testid='hero-heading', data-testid='letter-card', data-testid='signature' to key elements.

media.notes: No standard images are required. The visual impact is completely driven by the R3F 3D background canvas and the premium glassmorphic UI.

component_instructions.Background3D: A dedicated React component rendering the Three.js Canvas with the flowing silk (MeshDistortMaterial) and glowing stars (Sparkles).
component_instructions.GlassCard: A reusable layout wrapper component that applies the standard glassmorphic utility classes to ensure visual consistency.
component_instructions.FarewellLetter: The main view that breaks the long text into manageable array elements mapped to animated paragraphs.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Make sure the 3D background is absolutely or fixed positioned (e.g., fixed inset-0 z-[-1]) behind the content.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds on containers that hold text; the glassmorphism backdrop-blur is strictly required to maintain readability.
Prioritize mobile layout. Test typography size and card padding specifically against mobile dimensions.
Avoid centering massive blocks of text. Left-align the main body of the letter for a natural, emotional reading flow, while the hero text 'Michelle' can be centered.
Avoid all default browser scrollbars if possible; hide them to maintain the cinematic feel.
Break the letter content logically so it doesn't appear as one giant unreadable wall of text.
Ensure 'Michelle' is highly prominent in the hero section.
Include the Twilight Sparkle keychain mention gracefully as part of the letter.
Keep the entire experience silent, meaning absolutely no `<audio>` elements or music.
